name: jev.nonstream.non-derived-user-content-request-from-ir
description: A user message that is the §7.2 rendering of the reconstructed questions is derived and skipped without a loss; a second user message carrying independent content has no Jev destination and records one unsupported-semantic loss.

system.text:
State text.

Answer the structured questions that follow as a single JSON object. Keys MUST be exactly the question IDs given in the user message; values MUST match each question's type: noul answers are numbers in [0,1], choice answers are one of the listed option names, score answers are one of the listed level numbers. Output raw JSON only: no prose, no markdown fences.

content.text:
question tone (choice): What is the tone?
criteria:
- casual: Casual tone
- formal: Formal tone

expected_losses.detail: N-JEV-10: not the derived question rendering; Jev has no conversation turns
N-JEV-9: criteria descriptions live in the prompt text
